newsitem.title: CHINA: China Marine H1 net 99.76 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Marine H1 net 99.76 mln yuan.

text.p: China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd posted net profits of 99.76 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Per-share net reached 0.382 yuan in the first half, with net assets per share at 3.58 yuan, the exchange said in a notice after the market closed.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
For the first half of 1996, the company said its unaudited net profits reached 93.87 million yuan.
